Definition: Tachath, the name of a place in the Desert, also of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Tahath = "station"; n pr m; 1) a Kohathite Levite, son of Assir and father of Uriel; 2) a Kohathite Levite, son of Assir and father of Zephaniah; 2a) maybethe same as 1; 3) son of Bered, great grandson of Ephraim, and father of Eladah; 4) son of Eladah, grandson of 3, and father Zabad; n pr loc; 3) a station of Israel in the wilderness
